Horizontal shift
Adding a constant inside the function, moving the graph left or right

Absolute value function
A V-shaped function whose output is never negative

Three equations solved together, usually in three variables
Matrix
A rectangular array of numbers used to organise and solve systems

Polynomial Functions: Polynomial function
A function of terms with whole-number exponents
Degree
The highest exponent in a polynomial
Leading coefficient
The coefficient of the highest-degree term
End behavior
How a graph behaves as x approaches positive or negative infinity
Turning point
A point where a graph changes from rising to falling or the reverse
Multiplicity of a root
How many times a factor repeats, affecting whether the graph crosses or touches
Remainder theorem
Dividing by (x - a) leaves a remainder equal to f(a)
Factor theorem
(x - a) is a factor exactly when f(a) equals zero
Synthetic division
A shortcut for dividing a polynomial by a linear factor
Fundamental theorem of algebra
A degree n polynomial has exactly n roots counting complex and repeats
Rational root theorem
Possible rational roots are factors of the constant over factors of the leading coefficient

The small number showing which root is being taken

Recursive formula
